correctness.rationale: The uniform root split makes the left and right recursive subtrees conditionally independent. Total covariance yields a closed recurrence. For size at least four, the conditional mean leaf count differs from its global mean only at the four split sizes 0, 1, n-2, and n-1, by minus or plus one third. This converts the between-split term into two thirds over 3n times the difference of consecutive classical path-length means, producing a harmonic term that cancels exactly with the induction sum. The same split law proves the leaf variance, and exact enumeration independently checks the formulas.
